source.notes: Selected theme item reads BACKGROUND_BASE_LOWER through the selected base. Current resolver trace and pixel bounds confirm the Dark swatch effect.
references: manifest.json: current resolver trace and swatch pixel bounds

privacy.notes: Full images show the built-in App Theme demo, with canned names and messages; no account content.

visual.notes: Full before and after frames and the focused comparison were inspected. Only the selected swatch fill changes; restoration is exact.

annotation.notes: Outline sits inside the swatch fill. All four base swatches are visible at original scale.

unrelatedComponents.notes: Selection outline, the other swatches and the preview stay unchanged. Changed pixels are confined to the selected swatch.

description.notes: Colours the fill of the selected Dark swatch in App Theme.
